title: Kita is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified
summary: Inside Kita’s two-stage ISO/IEC 27001:2022 audit with Advantage Partners: what the auditor examined, how certification was decided, and what happens next.
body_markdown:
AI is moving into credit decisions faster than the assurance around it. The question serious lenders ask is not whether a model is clever. It is whether anyone can show what it did, on what evidence, and who signed off.


That is the bar we hold ourselves to. Every figure Kita produces traces back to the document and the page it came from. Every step is logged. The decision stays with the lender’s credit team. ISO/IEC 27001 puts an accredited auditor behind the part of that covering how we handle, protect, and account for the information itself.


## What the certificate covers


Certificate ISMS-KI-071526, issued on 15 July 2026 and valid to 15 July 2029 by Advantage Partners. The certified scope is Kita Capture, the Kita AI Credit Officer, the Kita AI Underwriter, the Kita Portal, and the Kita API, together with the assets and processes supporting them.


## How the audit worked


Certification was the external test at the end of a larger body of work. We defined the boundaries of our information security management system, assessed the risks to the information inside it, selected how those risks would be treated, documented the controls we rely on, and put the system through internal audit and management review. We use Vanta to collect and monitor supporting evidence, but the platform is only the record: the policies, technical safeguards, operating procedures, and people behind them are what the auditor examined.


Advantage Partners then conducted the initial certification audit in two stages. In Stage 1, the audit team evaluated the design and implementation of the relevant ISMS clauses—whether the scope, risk process, responsibilities, policies, and control framework formed a management system capable of meeting ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Stage 2 moved from design to operation. The team evaluated whether the relevant controls, including the controls selected from Annex A, were working in practice and supported by evidence.


Passing the audit did not automatically produce a certificate. Advantage Partners aggregated the findings and audit work papers for a separate certification review. Under its published process, the certification decision is made by authorized people who did not participate in the audit, and certification can be withheld while nonconformities remain open. Kita received the certificate only after that review was complete and the requirements were met.


The work continues after issuance. Advantage Partners will conduct surveillance audits during the three-year certificate cycle to verify that the ISMS remains effective, followed by a full recertification audit before renewal. We continue to maintain the controls and their evidence between those audit points rather than treating certification as a one-time exercise.


## About our auditor


[Advantage Partners](https://advantage-partners.com/assurance/iso27001/) is the trading name of Montlake Partner Group LLC, a US-based security and compliance firm focused on technology companies. Its ISO/IEC 27001 lead auditors hold Lead Auditor certifications, and the firm is also a certified Vanta partner. That combination gave the audit team context for a cloud software environment without changing the standard or the evidence Kita had to meet.


Advantage Partners is accredited by the International Accreditation Service to certify information security management systems against ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Its accreditation is listed as[IAS MSCB-389](https://www.iasonline.org/ias_certificate/mscb-389/) . Accreditation matters because it places the certification body itself under an external framework for competence, consistency, and impartiality. Advantage Partners also publishes its rules for independent certification decisions, surveillance, suspension, withdrawal, complaints, and appeals in its[certification process and policies](https://advantage-partners.com/iso-certification-process-policies/) .


## What it does not cover


ISO 27001 certifies a management system, not a product and not a model output. No certificate can tell you an extraction is correct. That is what the citation on every figure, the audit log, and your own credit team are for.


SOC 2 Type II is a separate engagement, still in progress. We will keep saying so until the report is issued.


## Verify it


The control set and supporting documentation are published at[trust.kita.ai](https://trust.kita.ai/) . The certificate and the SOC 2 engagement letter come on request fromsupport@kita.ai . It can also be checked in IAF CertSearch under Montlake Partner Group LLC, independently of anything we publish.
